description: This file defines a SwiftUI view that integrates a barcode QR code scanner using a UIKit view controller. It handles scanning logic, error reporting, and decoding of specific QR code payloads related to gateway connections.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A delegate object conforming to DataScannerViewControllerDelegate that manages QR code detection, error handling, and invoking callbacks upon scan results.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController for QR code scanning.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Updates the view controller; intentionally left empty.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and dismisses the scanner view when it's dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting by invoking the onError callback exactly once.
